paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.73, with a change of 14.85% compared to the prior close and a change of -26.53% over a window of 22 sessions. The price is as of July 30, 2026.

Other news includes updates on Project Matador and first-quarter results, with shares experiencing significant gains and losses over the past few days.
